text:
Kai: quick heads up — fp8 bring-up for model-x is failing on the A100 dedicated pool (prod container). h100 tests passed locally.

Josh: what error are you seeing?

Kai: error during TRT-LLM init, paste below:
```
[2026-03-20 10:14:32] trt-llm: loading engine for model-x.fp8.plan
[2026-03-20 10:14:32] trt-llm: cublasLtGetVersion failed: symbol not found
[2026-03-20 10:14:32] trt-llm: error: no fp8 kernels available for model precision path
[2026-03-20 10:14:32] trt-llm: aborting load, falling back not allowed by config
```

Mel: hmm that "symbol not found" smells like a host/container CUDA mismatch. what does `nvidia-smi` show on the nodes?

Kai: checked: node driver: 535.54, container base image built against CUDA 12.2. But the TRT-LLM binary was compiled in our ci image using CUDA 11.8 (weird).

Raj: aha. TRT-LLM + our FP8 kernels were built against a different cuBLAS/cuBLASLt ABI. A100 + driver 535 should still support ABI compatibility, but mixed CUDA major/minor in binary + system libs = undefined symbols.

Josh: can you repro with `docker run --rm --gpus all` on a dev A100 node using the same prod image? If it fails we can create a minimal repro.

Kai: reproduced on node-gpu-7 with the prod image. Minimal repro attached in the run: `/runs/17855-llm-fp8-repro` (infra-bot will link).

infra-bot: Repro job created: https://ci.redwood.internal/runs/17855-llm-fp8-repro (logs preserved).

Mel: quick workaround: force the runtime to fallback to the INT8 precision path for now. In the helm chart set `model.precisionPriority: [int8, fp8, fp16]` — that'll keep the service up.

Raj: longer-term fixes:
- Rebuild TRT-LLM plugin against the same CUDA/toolkit we use in prod containers (unify build matrix).
- Add startup driver/abi check in our image: at container entry run a tiny check that validates `cublasLtGetVersion` symbol is resolvable (ldd /path/to/trt_plugin). Fail fast with clear error.

Josh: can we add an automated gate in our rollout that detects this class of mismatch? e.g., try `dlopen` on libcuda/libcublas and a quick symbol probe before marking instance healthy.

Kai: yes — I can whip up a tiny probe script. I also saw a secondary issue: vLLM path (without TRT) loads fine but is ~2x slower. So customers hit perf regression if we fallback to vLLM for fp8-only models.

Raj: options:
- rebuild plugin (best perf)
- ship a compatibility image with explicit driver libs (risky)
- have runtime detect and auto-fallback to INT8/GPTQ quant artifacts with a warning and metric (safe)

Josh: for the immediate release let's do Mel's helm change + probe script + block rollout if probe fails. Kai, can you open an infra ticket with repro and tag SRE? Put the minimal repro steps and logs from the `trt-llm` crash.

Kai: opening ticket now. I'll include these logs + `ldd` output. Also including the snippet I used to probe symbol:
```bash
#!/bin/bash
python - <<PY
from ctypes import CDLL
try:
  lib = CDLL('libcublasLt.so')
  print('ok')
except Exception as e:
  print('symbol_probe_failed', e)
PY
```

ci-bot: Ticket created: INFRA-4127 — "trt-llm fp8: undefined cublasLt symbol on A100 prod". CI run attached: https://ci.redwood.internal/runs/17855-llm-fp8-repro

Mel: I'll open a PR to change the helm defaults for the canary (small change). Kai, add the probe script to the image layer in your PR too.

Raj: also add a metric `inference.precision_fallback` with tags {model, node, reason} so we can detect rollouts that silently degrade to slower paths.

Kai: yep. I'll start with a hotfix: helm change + metric + probe. Then a follow-up to rebuild plugin properly.

Josh: thanks — assign to me for deployment approval once the probe + metric land. :thumbsup:

Kai: thanks all. Will keep thread updated. :face_with_monocle:
